teaching_check.prompt: Using fit3, explain in Bahasa Indonesia why diagnostics limit ecological interpretation, preserve R names, ask one challenge and wait, then offer a hint after an incorrect answer.
teaching_check.challenge: Interpret ESS 36.0 for beta0_psi / OTU_3 and explain why it is insufficient here.
scientific_issues: Conflates Monte Carlo estimation error from low ESS with posterior/ecological uncertainty.
Claims credible intervals are too wide; interval width/direction cannot be inferred from poor diagnostics alone.
Treats the Rhat screen as definitive proof rather than diagnostic evidence; near-one values do not prove global convergence.
Followup gives a contradictory iteration count: (20 burn-in + 20 retained) times two chains is 80 sampler iterations, with 40 retained draws for diagnostics; burn-in is excluded.

ESS 36 relative to 40 retained draws does not by itself demonstrate strong autocorrelation or failed exploration; the high Rhat and short run remain separate concerns, and such short-run ESS estimates are unstable.
Followup changes the requested teaching ESS screen from 400 to 200 without explaining the change; neither threshold alone establishes reliable inference.

Followup describes a vague between-sample versus whole-chain variance ratio instead of explaining the autocorrelation-based ESS for estimating a mean; it again conflates Monte Carlo error with posterior uncertainty.
